Project 03 / Area of interest

Thinking at the nanoscale

2D materials, transistors and quantum phenomena. Looking for questions worth an experiment.

I’m interested in materials physics and what changes when electronics approaches the scale of individual atomic layers. My independent reading includes MoS₂, WS₂ and emerging transistor concepts.

This page describes an area I’m exploring, rather than completed research. I want to connect an understanding of physical principles with experiments and practical applications.
